pointer_source: GitHub Advisory Database / candidate survey (metadata only)

kept_files.note: Git::Lib#ls_files is upstream-verbatim: the unquoting of a quoted path token from the ls-files output is exactly the line the fix commit changed (a direct eval of the quoted token on one variant, a call to the EscapedPath decoder on the other)
Git::EscapedPath is upstream-verbatim and byte-identical at the pre-fix and fix commits (it predates the fix); present in both variants, used by ls_files on one of them

stand_ins.replaces: Git::Lib#command_lines, which spawns the git process and returns its output lines
stand_ins.with: a recorder that returns the output lines it is given and runs nothing
stand_ins.note: feeds the ls-files output so the property is observable in-process; it decides nothing about the content of the lines

reduction_removed: all Git::Lib methods and state unrelated to ls_files
the real process execution and output handling inside command_lines
pov_note: Benign control and proof-of-vulnerability probes authored by the Corsair chain at run time; none authored here. Property observable in-process: a quoted path token in the ls-files output is passed to eval on one variant (its embedded expression runs) and decoded as literal bytes on the other. No outbound network and no git binary.
